comments: Presets for the legacy transition build (cmake -S native). The standalone
Python-free application build is configured from the repository root:

configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Legacy nanobind extension build into native/build; identical to the tools/run_tests.sh native configuration.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: Dedicated sanitizer build directory; run native tests through tools/run_tests.sh so the sanitizer runtime is injected.

configurePresets.name: rtsan
configurePresets.description: RealtimeSanitizer build; requires the Homebrew LLVM clang because Apple clang lacks the sanitizer.

configurePresets.name: coverage
configurePresets.description: llvm-cov source coverage over the native translation units; consume via tools/native_coverage.sh.
